2607.04431.title: On Pairwise Quantile Regression -- Statistical Guarantees and Applications
2607.04431.paper_summary: Quantile regression provides a powerful tool for summarizing the conditional distribution of a real valued random variable (r.v.) of interest $Y$ as a function of covariates $Z$ in cases where it shows a large dispersion with high probability, going beyond the situation where standard least square regression is informative/predictive. This article aims to extend this methodology to the pairwise case, when the variable to be explained takes the form of a similarity function between two independent observations, such as pixelated ID photos, as input data of biometric systems) and the explanatory variables take the form of a pair of covariates of the observations, such as the age or the hair color. We establish theoretical guarantees for solutions of this statistical learning problem, considered here as empirical minimizers of a pairwise version of the pinball loss. Leveraging sharp concentration results for $U$-processes, we prove generalization bounds and identify mild conditions under which fast learning rates can be achieved. Confirming the probabilistic analysis, experiments based on simulation data also provide solid empirical evidence of the validity of the methodology promoted here for pairwise quantile regression. Finally, its usefulness from an application perspective is demonstrated by a detailed study aimed at analyzing errors in similarity scoring for facial recognition.
2607.04431.paper_summary_zh: 分位數回歸提供了一個強大的工具，用於總結感興趣的實值隨機變數 $Y$ 在協變數 $Z$ 的條件分佈，特別是在其顯示出高概率的大範圍時，超越了標準最小二乘回歸的資訊/預測情況。本文旨在將這一方法擴展到成對情況，當被解釋的變數以兩個獨立觀察之間的相似性函數的形式出現，例如像素化的身份照片，作為生物識別系統的輸入數據，而解釋變數則以觀察的協變數對的形式出現，例如年齡或髮色。我們為這個統計學習問題的解建立了理論保證，將其視為成對版本的彈球損失的經驗最小化器。利用 $U$-過程的尖銳集中結果，我們證明了泛化界限並確定了可以實現快速學習速率的溫和條件。確認概率分析的實驗基於模擬數據，還提供了該方法在成對分位數回歸中有效性的堅實實證證據。最後，通過一項詳細研究，展示了其在應用視角上的有用性，旨在分析面部識別中的相似性評分錯誤。
